name: Inworld SAVA (open voice activity + end-of-turn detection model)
summary: SAVA (Semantic-Acoustic Voice Activity) is one small streaming model (25.5M params) that returns two probabilities every 40 ms on 16 kHz audio: whether a frame holds speech, and whether the speaker's turn is complete. Uses sound and sentence context to ignore coughs, laughs, music and keyboard noise. Runs on a single CPU thread (3.8 ms per 40 ms frame on M3 Max); Inworld reports a 71 ms median completed-turn detection vs 210 ms for the open model it compared against.

access.notes: One Apache 2.0 license covers code and weights (patent grant included). HF repo ungated; weights auto-download on first use. Responds to any voice: no target-speaker selection.

procedure: Run sava run recording.wav (weights download from Hugging Face on first use)
For a microphone: pip install "inworld-sava[mic]" then sava mic
In code: sava.load('inworld/sava'), then sava.Session(model).push(audio) for streaming

verdict.why: Open (Apache 2.0) speech + end-of-turn detection in one CPU-light model, a building block for voice agents, NPC dialogue and live captioning. Benchmarks are the publisher's own; ungated weights, pip install.
